exposure: Maternal porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) infection
outcome: Hippocampal gene expression (TNF-a, IFN-g, myelin basic protein, MHCII, GFAP)
Estimated neuronal numbers in fetal dentate gyrus and subiculum
Relative integrated density of GFAP+ staining
cohort: Pregnant gilts inoculated with porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) at gestational day 76 and their fetal piglets, removed by cesarean section at gestational day 111.
finding: Maternal viral infection during the beginning of the last trimester in gilts led to decreased fetal brain weight, altered hippocampal gene expression, reduced neuronal numbers, and increased astrocyte-specific gliosis in fetal piglets.
gest_age: Fetal piglets observed at gestational day 111 (near full term, 3 days before anticipated parturition)
